data.long_meaning: From the Old English word 'frisel', meaning fragrant or meadow. This name evokes images of a lush, fragrant meadow filled with wildflowers and the sweet scent of nature.

data.cultural_impact: The name Frissell carries a refreshing and rejuvenating connotation, reminiscent of the allure and beauty of nature. It can be seen as a celebratory name, evoking feelings of joy, freshness, and vitality. Historically, this name may have been given to children born during times of abundant harvests or when nature was particularly vibrant, suggesting a connection to the earth and its bounty.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Frissell can be seen as a reminder of the divine and spiritual aspects of nature. The fragrance and freshness it represents can be seen as a reflection of the spiritual nourishment and renewal that comes from a deep connection with the natural world. Furthermore, it can serve as a reminder of the divine fragrance of our own souls, and the importance of allowing this fragrance to permeate every aspect of our lives, bringing purity and holiness to ourselves and all around us.
